feeds.title: Mostly Amélie
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Amélie. This is a yoga blog, a wellness travel and veganism diary, an attempt at a conscious lifestyle, and some tips on life as an expat in Berlin.

feeds.title: Justin Plus Lauren Blog
feeds.description: I'm Lauren Yakiwchuk. I started this blog as a memory of my travels with my partner, Justin. Now, it's a travel guide to help you! Justin and I travel together most of the time, but sometimes I go places by myself as a solo female traveler. I love writing about outdoor adventures, exploring cities and small towns, history, culture, architecture, and street art.

feeds.title: Veggie Visa
feeds.description: Veggie Visa's mission is to share tips and tricks to help you live a vegan lifestyle whether it's on the road or at home. I love trying out delicious vegan restaurants, shopping at awesome vegan-friendly stores, staying in eco-friendly hotels when I travel, and cooking quick and easy vegan recipes. I'm devoted to sharing all my finds, tips, and tricks with you so you can live a happier and healthier vegan lifestyle.

feeds.title: Voyaging Herbivore
feeds.description: Voyaging Herbivore is a guide to ethical, sustainable, plant-based travel. For vegan travel tips and slow travel, itineraries look no further!

feeds.title: The Healthy Voyager
feeds.description: In this blog, you will find all things healthy, vegan and green lifestyle, recipes and travel from a Latina holistic nutritionist, vegan chef, cookbook author & TV show host!

feeds.title: Omventure Blog
feeds.description: Intentional. Sustainable. Travel and Living. To peacefully adventure through this life. A former crisis counselor and health professional, it's deeply meaningful to me to travel and live with intention and sustainability - to peacefully adventure through this life. Omventure is my journal and photo album, where I share the ongoing exploration of slow travel, extreme minimalist, (gluten-free) vegan, and mindful adventure.

feeds.title: Hey Roseanne
feeds.description: Roseanne Ducut, a solo traveler and Kapampángan from California writes travel destination and vegan guides as she explores the world. On her site HeyRoseanne.com you'll find 'best of' city guides and practical travel tips without the fluff, plus my reviews of vegan food from around the world.

feeds.title: Veggies Abroad Vegan Travel Blog
feeds.description: Vegan travel blog featuring travel guides, tips and resources to explore the world and find tasty vegan food along the way.

feeds.title: Vegan Food Quest Blog
feeds.description: Vegan Food Quest writes about vegan travel in Southeast Asia and beyond with vegan travel guides and vegan-friendly luxury hotel and resort reviews to help you find the tastiest vegan food and the best vegan-friendly luxury hotels and resorts in the region.

feeds.title: Will Travel For Vegan Food Blog
feeds.description: My name is Kristin and shortly after becoming vegan, I fell in love with food. More precisely, dining out, where and how to find it, and adventure in the name of delicious discoveries. Since this journey began I've had the privilege of visiting all 50 states, more than 20 countries, and dining at thousands of vegan eateries, quite literally around the world.

feeds.title: My Veggie Travels
feeds.description: I can't decide what I love the most, finding new ways and places to travel on a budget, or finding a new spot to sample vegan food. For that reason, I write about both. Here, you will find travel information, guides, and tips for vegan travel and budget travel.

feeds.title: Herbivores' Heaven
feeds.description: I am Jenny, and I'm on a mission to visit as many European cities as possible, and eat all the good vegan food I can find! So, please enjoy the recipes and reviews on my blog.

feeds.title: My Vegan Trips
feeds.description: My name is Emily, I am an Italian, a vegan, and a traveler. All I'm willing to do here is sharing with you the best places I'm visiting, the best and cheapest ways to get there, where to sleep, and most of all how to find inexpensive vegan food wherever you are.

feeds.title: The Nomadic Vegan
feeds.description: Your go-to source for vegan travel information. I show you how you can be vegan anywhere and spread compassion everywhere, eating vegan food around the world.

feeds.title: The Vegan Word
feeds.description: I'm Caitlin and I'm here to show you how to travel the world and find vegan food anywhere. Because stress-free, meat-free travel is possible. I've also written two vegan travel guidebooks and been featured in The New York Times, Lonely Planet, and Yahoo.

feeds.title: World Vegan Travel Blog
feeds.description: Find out the latest news, travel tips, and more to help you get the most out of your vegan travel experiences and have vegan holiday memories.

feeds.title: Bounding Over Our Steps
feeds.description: We're the traveling team of Ligeia, a US-American, and Mindy, a Canadian, currently calling Florida, USA home, where Ligeia is an ESL language instructor and Mindy works in freelance web design, both professions allowing for a nomadic life. We started this blog way back in December 2005, with the primary intention of keeping our friends and family up to date with what was going on with us. Today, we hope to reach a broader audience that is not only interested in our daily lives, but also fellow travelers that share one or more similar interests.

feeds.title: Fly Me To The Vegan Buffet
feeds.description: I'm Nina and as a flight attendant I have been enjoying amazing vegan food all over the world for the last 13 years. I love playing around with these inspirations in my fusion kitchen at home in Berlin - usually creating something new. On this blog I share my favourite recipes and travel & lifestyle tips for vegans and those who are interested.

feeds.title: Vegan World Trekker
feeds.description: Hello Vegan Travelers! My name is Maria, the 'Vegan World Trekker'. This blog contains valuable information on vegan dining worldwide, airport and airline food options, vegan travel guides, vegan accommodations and trips, vegan clothing, vegan travel gear, and photos from my international trips, plus each of my trips and some travel advice!

feeds.title: Alternative Travelers
feeds.description: Want to travel sustainably, as a vegan, or long-term? We're here to show you that it doesn't have to be expensive or difficult.

feeds.title: Veggie Vagabonds Blog
feeds.description: Veggie Vagabonds blog has everything you need to plan your outdoor adventures, keep 'em vegan, and make 'em green! Josh & Sarah, two self-confessed outdoor-loving, tree-hugging vegans and proud parents behind Veggie Vagabonds.
